oneOf.description:
A volume is forecast to drop below its reserve soon (PRO-01: time-based, default
within 14 days).
A volume is already below its reserve (measured).
Worktrees, build outputs or caches idle longer than their staleness window (PRO-02).
An agent or script worktree is past its registered TTL (PRO-08).
A category, ecosystem or path is over its size budget (PRO-03).
A category grew faster than the spike threshold (PRO-04).
A volume lost free space faster than the spike threshold (PRO-04).

DigestSchedule.description: When the weekly digest is sent, in the user's local time.

enabled.description: Whether the digest is sent at all. **Off by default** (opt-in, INS-04).

utc_offset_secs.description: The user's offset from UTC in seconds (east positive), as the app's clock reports it.

weekday.description: Day of the week, `0` = Monday … `6` = Sunday.

MonitorMemory.description:
What the monitor remembers between checks. Plain data: the app keeps it across restarts so
a restart doesn't repeat yesterday's notifications.

digest_since.description:
When the digest was found turned on without having been sent (its first slot is the
next one after this).

last_digest.description: When the last digest was sent.

MonitorSettings.description:
What the user chose for tray monitoring. Every field has a default, so a partial JSON
object (or `{}`) is valid; [`MonitorSettings::normalized`] clamps out-of-range values.

alert_days.description:
Days ahead a disk-full forecast alerts (overrides `[proactive] alert_days` for the
tray's own forecast; `None`: the configured value).

alerts.description: Notify about alerts at all (the digest has its own switch).

cooldown_secs.description:
Seconds before the same alert (same key and severity) is notified again
([`MIN_COOLDOWN_SECS`]..=[`MAX_COOLDOWN_SECS`]). A worse severity notifies at once.

min_severity.description: Alerts below this severity never notify (default: warning).

muted_kinds.description: Alert kinds that never notify (e.g. growth spikes when "Sudden growth" is off).

muted_subjects.description:
Subjects that never notify: a volume, category or folder; a folder also mutes
everything below it.

paused_until.description: Nothing is notified before this time (Unix seconds); `None`: not paused.

Severity.description: How urgent an alert is. Ordered: `Info < Warning < Critical`.

description:
`configure_monitor`'s argument: the user's settings and, on the first call after start,
the memory the app kept from its previous run.

memory.description:
Memory from the previous run; ignored after the first `configure_monitor`, so a
settings change never rewinds what was already notified.

settings.description: Settings (partial objects take defaults; values are clamped).
